name: Jeffrey Berman
office: City of Santa Clarita, Member of the City Council, 4th District

items.text: Jeffrey Berman is a candidate for Santa Clarita City Council, District 4, with no party on the ballot. His campaign says he worked as a writer and filmmaker and spent more than a decade in ethics and compliance.

sentences.text: Jeffrey Berman is a candidate for Santa Clarita City Council, District 4, with no party on the ballot.
His campaign says he worked as a writer and filmmaker and spent more than a decade in ethics and compliance.

items.text: He says traffic is the top issue he hears from residents, and he wants to reduce congestion and fix dangerous intersections. He wants to make sure new development does not create traffic and safety problems for existing neighborhoods. He also wants to explore expanded hospital-level pediatric care in Santa Clarita and expanded student transportation.
